# discord_guild_emoji (Resource)

Manages a Discord guild custom emoji. Supports static and animated images, role restrictions, and import by server_id:emoji_id. The bot requires CREATE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS; managing emojis created by others requires MANAGE_GUILD_EXPRESSIONS.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_local_image" "emoji" {
  file = "${path.module}/assets/star-yes.png"
}

resource "discord_guild_emoji" "example" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "star_yes"
  image     = data.discord_local_image.emoji.data_uri

  # Omit role_ids to allow everyone. An empty set clears existing restrictions.
  # role_ids = ["123456789012345678"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) Base64 image data URI, for example discord_local_image.data_uri. Supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, and AVIF, up to 256 KiB decoded. Use 128x128 images. Changing the image replaces the emoji and changes its ID; image data cannot be read back from Discord after import.
- `name` (String) The emoji name: 2-32 ASCII letters, digits, or underscores.
- `server_id` (String) The server (guild) ID. Changing it replaces the emoji.

### Optional

- `role_ids` (Set of String) Role IDs allowed to use this emoji. Omit or set to an empty set to allow everyone. Removing restrictions updates the existing emoji.

### Read-Only

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether Discord identifies this emoji as animated.
- `id` (String) The ID of the emoji.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import discord_guild_emoji.example 123456789012345678:234567890123456789
```
